Definition: of Hebrew origin (H5416); Nathan, an Israelite:--Nathan.
BiblicalUsage: Nathan stands in the genealogy Luke draws from Joseph back to David, the son of David through whom the line runs on toward Jesus. He is named once, in the long chain of fathers and sons that carries the promise forward.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the quiet names in the genealogy matter: without Nathan the line from David to Jesus would have a gap, and God wrote even the quiet links into His story.
RelatedPeople: Nathan, Son of David; King David
